title.zh: Ethereum Proposal Would Let Users Pay Gas Without Holding ETH
title.en: Ethereum Proposal Would Let Users Pay Gas Without Holding ETH

current_state.zh: EIP-8141 proposes 'Frame' transactions to let Ethereum users pay gas fees in tokens or have others pay, potentially removing the need to hold ETH for gas.
